column1: # T-SQL token forms for generated compat rows: the text written for each
# token of TSql160.g4 that is a class of texts, or that ScriptDOM's lexer
# makes only by setting a type ($setType). Keywords and punctuation spell
# themselves and need no row. Each note cites the lexer rule in TSql160.g,
# whose lexer matches keywords in any case (caseSensitiveLiterals = false).
